messages:
Maya: Quick QA — spotted that the Southeast Asia availability table lists Singapore but misses Jakarta (id). Also no data-residency footnote for Indonesia. Draft here: https://redwood-internal.docs/sea-availability/draft-jkt. Can someone add a short residency line and a Go SDK header example? Need this for a localization PR tomorrow.

Sam: Yep — add Jakarta row. For the residency phrasing legal should review. Suggest: 'Data processed in-region where available; see residency FAQ.' @Evan can you sign off?

Evan: @Sam — that wording is fine. Please avoid words like 'sovereignty' or 'guarantee'. Use: 'Processed in-region where available; contact support for on-prem/VPC options.'

Liam: I'll add the table row + footnote. Quick Go SDK snippet we can reuse: 
```go
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Region", "ap-southeast-5")
// or client config:
client := redwood.NewClient("$API_KEY", redwood.WithRegion("ap-southeast-5"))
```
I'll open a PR in a few mins.

Sophie: Ping me on the PR and I'll run the doc link-checker + fix any "legacy path" redirects. Also suggest we add a short note: 'Availability subject to capacity and model catalog.'

Maya: One more thing — include a tiny migration note for customers using legacy region codes (e.g., ap-southeast -> ap-southeast-1). A mapping table would be great. @Liam can you add that to the same PR?

Liam: Will do. Also adding a curl example for ops folks:
```bash
curl -H "X-Redwood-Region: ap-southeast-5" \\https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5123

docs-bot: Link-checker: 1 broken link found in draft — /old-paths/sea -> 404. Commented on PR.

Sophie: Fixed the internal link and re-ran checks, all green now :white_check_mark: 

Maya: Final ask — add a one-line in the SDK migration guide: 'The region header supersedes the legacy region parameter.' Keep it terse. I'll merge after one review.

Liam: Adding that sentence to the migration section now. Thanks all!
